lines.text: Joab refuses Ahimaaz at first and sends a Cushite, but Ahimaaz insists, runs by way of the plain, and outruns him.
David sits between the two gates while a watchman on the gateway roof sees two men running alone and names the first as Ahimaaz.
Ahimaaz bows before David and says the king's son is dead, so David asks no question about Absalom.

wrong_details.wrong: Ahimaaz says the king's son is dead and David asks no question about Absalom
wrong_details.true: David asks if Absalom is all right, and Ahimaaz says he saw a great tumult but does not know what it was

lines.text: The Cushite tells David that Absalom is dead, and David goes up to the chamber over the gate and weeps.
Joab tells David to comfort his servants or lose every man by morning, so David sits in the gate at Mahanaim.

wrong_details.true: not a man will remain with him tonight

wrong_details.wrong: sits in the gate at Mahanaim
wrong_details.true: the king sits in the gate (no place name given; the people come before him)
